audit.why: Sylas bullies the immobile pre-Tear Ryze, Ryze spikes at first item/Tear, Sylas retakes at two items. Matches kits and 51.44% WR over 4053 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart disagrees with content and packet on five rows: rows 1,2,4 read Skill (should be Sylas), row 6 reads Skill (should be Ryze), row 7 reads Ryze (should be Sylas).
audit.why: Content whys and packet levelChart agree row for row: Sylas x5, Ryze at first item, Sylas at 2+ items.
audit.corrected: Five full-layer sides realigned with grounded whys and ratings; win[N] already correct on every row so no content chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: Cooldowns field calls Rune Prison a 'point-blank root' with no numbers — it is a 615-range cage that only roots when Spell Flux is on the target (otherwise a slow); trade strings are the lane template; two Do/Don't bodies are pasted trade strings.
audit.why: Kit authority: W Rune Prison 11-9s roots only with Flux; E Spell Flux cycles every 3.5-2.5s and resets Overload; R Realm Warp is 180/160/140s utility. The Flux condition is the matchup's core interaction — engage unmarked, disengage before the E-W-Q chain.
audit.corrected: Cooldowns field now states the Flux condition with 11-9s/3.5s/180s; trades grounded in bait-the-root and don't-chain-in-marked; Do/Don't bodies rewritten to match their titles using the R-cooldown asymmetry.

edits.before: Ryze wins by landing Rune Prison (Root), denying your pattern, and keeping the fight at a distance your kit resents.
edits.after: Ryze wins by tagging you with Spell Flux so Rune Prison roots, then chaining Overloads while you sit in the cage.

edits.before: E-shield in, E2-chain, Q-W with whirls between, heal out — the full brawl string he answered with one rotation and regret.
edits.after: Bait Rune Prison, then E-shield in, chain, Q-W with whirls, heal out — without the Flux root he cannot hold you in place.

edits.before: Chaining into a loaded CC with W down — Sylas without the heal is a mage who chose melee for the aesthetic.
edits.after: Chaining in Flux-marked with W down — the E-W root into Overload chain deletes a Sylas who cannot heal out.

edits.before: Ahead, monopolize: brawl Ryze off every contact, steal the map's best button on cooldown, and flank fights with their own game plan.
edits.after: Ahead, deny his farm: he must walk up to clear pre-Tear, so chain every step-up and shove before his 180s Realm Warp windows.

edits.before: Q-poke the wave contacts — the chain detonation chips while you wait for the real kit at 3.
edits.after: Pre-Tear Ryze is at his weakest — out-poke the immobile mage and win the opening trades.

edits.before: W joins: the heal-strike makes even trades dishonest — yours refunds, his doesn't.
edits.after: W joins: even trades turn dishonest — your heal refunds and his kit has no answer to it.

edits.before: Chain-trade on cooldown: shield in, stun, whirl the passive autos, heal out. The brawl is the plan.
edits.after: Chain-trade on cooldown: shield in, whirl, heal out — pre-Tear he lacks the mana to answer every brawl.

edits.before: First item spike: full chains with a stolen ult delete or out-brawl anything mid offers.
edits.after: His Tear-stacked first item spike: the Flux root turns reliable — respect this one window.

edits.before: Late Sylas shops the enemy team: steal the fight-flipper, flank with it, and heal through the refund policy.
edits.after: At two items your burst plus a stolen ult beats his utility scaling — dive him before Realm Warp matters.

edits.before: - Ryze Rune Prison (Root): matchup-defining — Point-blank root — respect the EQ chain that follows it. Check it before every step-up. - E Abscond (shield-dash) is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Rune Prison: 11-9s, 615 range — it only roots you when Spell Flux is on you; unmarked, it's just a slow. - Overload resets on his 3.5s E — the EQ chain is constant, so never eat it rooted. - E Abscond is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.
